title: Holographic entanglement entropy in Chern-Simons gravity with torsion
summary: Holographic entanglement entropy is a key concept linking quantum information theory and gravity. Since the original conjecture of Ryu and Takayanagi, holographic entanglement entropy has been generalized beyond Einstein--Hilbert gravity to include higher-curvature corrections. In most existing generalizations, however, it is implicitly assumed that the bulk spacetime geometry is Riemannian, i.e. torsion-free.
